_comment: v11.44 read-side actor canonicalization fold-table. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH, loaded by BOTH bash (v11_canonical_actor in hooks/lib/common.sh) and Python (scripts/lib/actor_canonical.py, used by agent-scorecard / agent-effectiveness). Folds the orchestrator identity family to one canonical actor so it becomes scoreable. Non-family inputs pass through UNCHANGED (non-lossy — real project agents like sofly-engineer are never forced to 'unknown'). Gated by V11_ORCH_QUALITY=off (legacy literal-string match).
